reasoning: Blue's composition lacks a hard engage support to complement K'Sante's dive and Jinx's teamfight damage, and Leona's chain-CC (Zenith Blade into Solar Flare) lets Blue force fights on their terms rather than get engaged on by Rakan/Sejuani/Gnar. She also gives Blue a reliable way to lock down Varus or Orianna before they can set up their own combos.
enemy_threat_addressed: Rakan's dive/engage potential alongside Sejuani and Gnar

alternatives.why: Strong peel and anti-AD stats to protect Jinx from Varus/MF poke and enemy dive.
Tanky engage/disengage tool with Sapling Toss zoning and a hard CC ultimate against dive comps.
